turn.text:
Turn on antivirus using the signature database and block known malware in HTTP downloads for the user zone.

Enable signature-based malware blocking for HTTP downloads in the user zone (Suricata EICAR rule).
Plan: echo 'alert http any any -> any any (msg:"EICAR"; content:"EICAR-STANDARD-ANTIVIRUS-TEST-FILE"; sid:1000001;)' >> /etc/suricata/rules/local.rules; suricata-update && systemctl restart suricata
